content_zh:
“小天啊，你已经开启体魄，以后可要为村子出一份力咯！”
“是啊，这些年大家没少照顾你和龙老头，可要好好报答大家。”
“小天，现在你已成为火云宗弟子，就不要与龙泉爷爷计较，其实爷爷以前数落你，都是为了你好，希望你成才。”
对于村人的恭维，龙泉的变脸，无天并未有太多情绪，淡淡回应几句，便径直走向等候多时的火云宗两人。
“师兄师姐，可以走了。”无天道。
华服少年点了点头，面无表情，跃上火烈鸟，少女紧随其后。
无天深深的看了眼爷爷所在的木屋，一言不发，跳了上去。
“起！”男子喝道。
火烈鸟尖锐鸣叫，冲上天际，快速消失在众人眼前。
“小畜生，别以为去了火云宗就没事，嘿嘿，好戏还在后面。”龙河望着天空，冷笑连连。
寒风凛冽，无天趴在鸟背上，不敢动弹，这是他第一次骑乘飞行妖兽，也是第一次在处于万丈空中，心中颇为忐忑，阵阵晕眩袭来，脸色发白。
“呱！”小天趴在他的头上，狭长的眸子，始终注视着那一男一女，带着警惕。
“啊，魔蛙，好恶心。”一道尖叫声响起，那少女本能的后退，躲在男子身后，厌恶相视，连带着无天。
魔蛙是低级妖兽，甚至还算不上妖兽，且长相恶心，任何一个女子见到，都会厌恶，避而远之。
“师妹，不可无礼！”华服少年斥责，但眼中同样有着鄙夷，能与魔蛙为伍的人，他根本看不上眼，若不是对方好歹也是俢者，还有林山的这层关系，理都懒得去理。
无天渐渐开始适应高空，坐了起来，双腿却依然在微微颤抖，将小天抓在手中，抱歉道：“师姐，不好意思，吓着你了。”
女子不答，容颜上的厌恶更浓。
无天无所谓的笑了笑，并没多说，小天长相确实不如人意，但经过这段时间相处，是他除了爷爷之外，第二个亲人。而且经历了一个月前的事情，他明白了怀璧有罪的道理，若是让两人知道小天的真实身份，恐怕又会如龙河那般，杀人夺宝。
此刻，无天才注意到，两人长相颇为不凡，都在十三四岁，一身实力如同汪洋般，看之不透，无法揣摩。
稍稍看了几眼，无天将目光移向大地。

火烈鸟浑身鳞甲，巴掌大，如岩浆而铸，通红如火，传递出丝丝暖意，下方山影叠叠，巍峨雄伟，无天牢牢的抓住一片鳞甲，好奇的打量着。
赤阳山脉很广阔，延绵万里，奇物怪景，多不胜数，无天头一次走出龙村，见到这宏伟的一幕，心中的震撼感，越发不可收拾。
“无天，我是火云宗宗主之子火世。这位是刘燕师妹，别看刘师妹是女子，但她可是大长老的亲传弟子，还拥有火灵体，在火云宗所有弟子中，实力能排到前十。”这时，华服少年无天惊讶道：“这么强！”
“别听师兄的胡说，要说强，师兄才是真正的强，拥有火木双灵体不说，如今才十四岁，修为就已经达到脱胎圆满期，在这整个青龙洲年轻一辈之中都不可多见。”
“双元素灵体！”
无天震惊，龙虎具有火灵体，就已经相当罕见，却没想到，面前这位仅仅比自己小两岁的少年，竟会是双灵体拥有者，果真是山外有山，人外有人。
“见过火师兄，刘师姐，师弟初来乍到，以后还请多多关照。”无天拱手道，宗门的辈分都是以实力衡量，这点他还是懂。
火世淡淡道：“关照可以，但需要代价，就是不知，无天师弟舍不舍得付出。”
“火师兄说笑了，小弟一介乡野，身无长物，怎么可能会有东西，能进入师兄师姐的法眼。”无天很谦诚。
“也不尽然吧！”男子淡淡道，嘴角勾出一抹意味深长的笑容。
“呱！”
这时，小天鸣叫，对火世两人来说，这只是寻常的叫声，但无天却能清楚的感觉到，这声音中带着一丝焦躁。
而造成这样的现象，正是火世的笑容。
经过一个月相处，无天对小天相当了解，对于危机的预感，超乎常人，二十多天在后山历练，若不是它独特的预感，恐早已身死，葬入妖兽腹中。
而此刻身在空中，身边没有他物，不可能有妖兽来袭，唯一的解释，就是火世两人。

content_en:
"My dear, you have opened up your body, and you will be able to contribute to the village in the future!"
"Yes, we have taken good care of you and Old Man Long these years, but we must repay everyone well."
"Xiaotian, now that you have become a disciple of the Fire Cloud Sect, don't argue with Grandpa Longquan. In fact, Grandpa scolded you before, all for your own good. I hope you will become a talented person."
Regarding the villagers' compliments and Long Quan's change of expression, Wu Tian didn't have much emotion. He responded with a few words and then went straight to the two people from the Fire Cloud Sect who had been waiting for a long time.
"Brother and sister, you can leave." Wutian said.
The handsome boy nodded, expressionless, and jumped onto the flamingo, followed closely by the girl.
Wutian took a deep look at the wooden house where his grandfather was, and jumped up without saying a word.
"Get up!" the man shouted.
The flamingo screamed sharply, rushed into the sky, and quickly disappeared from everyone's eyes.
"Little beast, don't think that everything will be fine if you go to the Fire Cloud Sect. Hehe, the fun is yet to come." Long He looked at the sky and sneered again and again.
The cold wind was biting, and Wutian lay on the back of the bird, not daring to move. This was his first time riding a flying monster, and it was also his first time in the sky. He felt quite uneasy, and was struck by waves of dizziness, and his face turned pale.
"Quack!" Xiaotian lay on his head, his narrow eyes always watching the man and woman with vigilance.
"Ah, Demon Frog, how disgusting." A scream rang out, and the girl instinctively retreated and hid behind the man, looking at each other with disgust and Wutian.
The Demon Frog is a low-level monster, not even a monster, and it looks disgusting. Any woman who sees it will be disgusted and avoid it.
"Junior sister, don't be rude!" the young man in fine clothes scolded, but there was also contempt in his eyes. He didn't look down on anyone who could associate with the devil frog at all. If it weren't for the fact that the other party was someone else after all, and Lin Shan's relationship, he wouldn't even bother to deal with it.
Wutian gradually began to adapt to the high altitude and sat up, but his legs were still shaking slightly. He held Xiaotian in his hand and apologized: "Sister, I'm sorry, I scared you."
The woman didn't answer, and the disgust on her face became even stronger.
Wutian smiled indifferently and didn't say much. Xiaotian's appearance was indeed not as good as expected, but after spending this time together, he became his second relative besides his grandfather. And after experiencing what happened a month ago, he understood the reason why Huai Bi was guilty. If the two of them knew Xiao Tian's true identity, they would probably kill people and seize the treasure like Long He did.
At this moment, Wu Tiancai noticed that the two of them looked quite extraordinary. They were both thirteen or fourteen years old, and their strength was as strong as the ocean, which was difficult to see and understand.
After looking at it for a while, Wutian turned his gaze to the earth.
The flamingo is covered in scales, the size of a palm, cast like lava, red as fire, conveying a hint of warmth. The mountain shadows below are stacked, majestic and majestic. Wutian firmly grasps a piece of scales and looks at it curiously.
The Chiyang Mountains are very vast, stretching for thousands of miles, and there are countless strange things and strange sights. Wutian walked out of Longcun for the first time and saw this magnificent scene, and the shock in his heart became more and more uncontrollable.
"Wutian, I am Huo Shi, the son of the leader of the Fire Cloud Sect. This is Junior Sister Liu Yan. Even though Junior Sister Liu is a woman, she is a direct disciple of the Great Elder. She also has a fire spirit body. Among all the disciples of the Fire Cloud Sect, her strength ranks among the top ten." At this time, Wu Tian, a young man in gorgeous clothes, said in surprise: "So strong!"
"Don't listen to senior brother's nonsense. When it comes to being strong, senior brother is truly strong. Not to mention possessing the dual spirit body of fire and wood, he is only fourteen years old, and his cultivation has already reached the stage of perfection. He is rare among the younger generation in the entire Qinglong Continent."
"Dual elemental spirit!"
Wutian was shocked. It was quite rare for Longhu to have a fire spirit body. However, he did not expect that the young man in front of him, who was only two years younger than himself, would actually be the owner of a double spirit body. It is true that there are mountains beyond the mountains and people beyond the human beings.
"I've met Senior Brother Huo and Senior Sister Liu. Junior Brother is new here. Please take good care of me in the future." WuTian Gongshou said that the seniority of the sect is measured by strength, and he still understands this.
Huo Shi said calmly: "You can take care of me, but it requires a price. I just don't know whether Junior Brother Wutian is willing to pay for it."
"Senior Brother Huo is joking. I live in the countryside and have nothing. How can I have something that can enter the eyes of senior brother and sister?" Wu Tian was very humble.
"That's not necessarily true!" the man said lightly, with a meaningful smile on his lips.
"Quack!"
At this time, Xiaotian screamed. To the two people in Huo Shi, this was just an ordinary scream, but Wutian could clearly feel that there was a hint of anxiety in the voice.
And it was the smile of the Fire World that caused this phenomenon.
After a month of getting along, Wutian got to know Xiaotian quite well, and his premonition of crisis was beyond ordinary people. After more than 20 days of experience in the back mountain, if it hadn't been for his unique premonition, he would have died long ago and been buried in the belly of a monster.
But at this moment, he was in the air, with nothing else around him, so there could be no monster coming. The only explanation was the two people from the Fire World.
